description:
Perform a comprehensive audit of the interaction profile for 'Capecitabine' in the Liverpool Cancer iChart app. 

1. Launch the app and find 'Capecitabine' in the Cancer Drugs list.
2. Enter the Interaction check section for this drug.
3. Systematically open EVERY co-medication category listed (e.g., Analgesics, Antibiotics, etc.).
4. Count the number of individual drugs listed in each category.
5. Create a report file at '/sdcard/Download/capecitabine_audit.txt' with the following format:

CAPECITABINE INTERACTION AUDIT
==============================
Total number of co-medication categories: [N]

Category breakdown:
- [Category Name]: [count] co-medications
...

Category with most entries: [Category Name] ([count] co-medications)
Total individual co-medications across all categories: [total]

Your report must rely on the ACTUAL data found in the app. Do not use synthetic numbers.
